narrative:
Good morning. Here is the MoraBanc FY2026 snapshot as of this morning.

**Revenue** — net operating income: the Q3 forecast is EUR 211.2M against the EUR 216.8M budget, EUR 5.6M short. Rates explain most of it: Euribor resets and lower reinvestment yields take EUR 4.0M out of retail and treasury income, while Tressis flows run 30% above budget.

**Profit** is forecast at EUR 65.9M against a EUR 68.3M budget and EUR 62.8M in FY2025. The efficiency ratio is 60.7%.

**Capital and liquidity** remain the strengths: CET1 20.17% (5.9 points over requirement) and LCR 261%.

**Pending your decision:** 4 items — NII repricing overlay, MoraBanc SA Q3 sign-off, CET1 impact of corporate RWA growth and a Risk & AML hiring exception.

signals.title: Q3 forecast €5.6M below budget
signals.excerpt: Net operating income €211.2M vs €216.8M budget: treasury −€2.2M, retail −€1.8M, private banking −€1.2M, corporate −€0.9M, asset management +€0.7M.

signals.title: CET1 down to 20.17% at June 2026
signals.excerpt: CET1 capital of €346.8M on €1,719M of risk-weighted assets; 5.9 points of headroom over the 14.28% overall capital requirement.

signals.title: Net fees now exceed net interest income
signals.excerpt: Net fees €91.6M vs NII €80.8M; gross fees +33% to €132.9M with Tressis and the Spanish bank in the perimeter.
